title: Forecasting GPU Performance for Deep Learning Training and Inference
authors: Seonho Lee; Amar Phanishayee; Divya Mahajan
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2025)
research_focus: Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Capacity planning, Distributed training

problem_statement.en: Access to newer GPUs is limited by long lead times (up to 52 weeks for H100) and high cost, so practitioners need to predict the performance of new or existing DL models on unseen GPUs, for both training and inference, without executing them; prior regression- and MLP-based predictors show high percentage error on unseen models and GPUs.
problem_statement.zh: 新款 GPU 因交期長（H100 可達 52 週）且成本高而難以取得，因此使用者需要在不實際執行的情況下，預測新舊 DL 模型在未見過 GPU 上的訓練與推理效能；既有的迴歸式與 MLP 式預測器在未見過的模型與 GPU 上誤差偏高。

key_innovation.en: NeuSight decomposes each DNN kernel prediction into tile-granularity sub-problems, mirroring how GPU libraries dispatch tiles across SMs: an MLP predicts per-tile utilization (sigmoid-bounded and capped by roofline performance laws) from publicly available GPU specs (memory size/bandwidth, peak FLOPS, SM count, L2 cache size), then wave-based aggregation yields kernel, per-GPU, and single-server distributed latency with analytical network-operator estimates.
key_innovation.zh: NeuSight 仿照 GPU 函式庫將 kernel 切成 tile 並分派至各 SM 的執行方式，把每個 DNN kernel 的延遲預測分解為 tile 粒度的子問題：以 MLP 從公開的 GPU 規格（記憶體容量/頻寬、峰值 FLOPS、SM 數、L2 cache 大小）預測每個 tile 的利用率（經 sigmoid 限制並受 roofline 效能定律約束），再以 wave 為單位聚合出 kernel、單 GPU 以及單一伺服器內分散式執行的延遲（網路運算子以分析式方法估算）。

baselines_compared: Roofline analysis, Habitat, Li et al. (linear regression)

key_improvements.en: Reduces percentage error for GPT3 latency on unseen H100 from 121.4% (MLP-based) and 30.8% (linear regression) to 2.3%; overall 8.9% error on out-of-distribution GPUs (H100, L4, A100-80GB) vs 140% and 60.8% for prior work; 5.4% error for distributed training on 4-GPU servers.
key_improvements.zh: 在未見過的 H100 上預測 GPT3 延遲的誤差由 121.4%（MLP 式）與 30.8%（線性迴歸）降至 2.3%；在 out-of-distribution GPU（H100、L4、A100-80GB）上整體誤差為 8.9%，優於既有工作的 140% 與 60.8%；在 4-GPU 伺服器上的分散式訓練誤差為 5.4%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA A100-80GB, NVIDIA A100-40GB, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA T4, NVIDIA V100, NVIDIA P100, NVIDIA P4, AMD MI100, AMD MI210, AMD MI250, HBM
gpu_count: 4x H100 (DGX Box), 4x A100-40GB (NVLink) for distributed; 11 GPU models single-device
reported_accuracy: MAPE 2.3% (GPT3 on unseen H100); avg 8.1% on out-of-distribution GPUs (max 28.2%); 7.7% distributed training
models_validated: BERT-Large, GPT2-Large, GPT3-XL, GPT3-2.7B, OPT-1.3B, Switch Transformer

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes kernels execute sequentially on the device; distributed support covers data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism on a single multi-GPU server with the parallelism type, width, and schedule provided by the user; multi-node forecasts (up to 3840 nodes) rely on analytical network estimates and are not validated on a real cluster; training dataset collected in FP32 with PyTorch; inference latency for text generation is measured as time to generate the first token (decode/KV cache not modeled).
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設 kernel 在裝置上循序執行；分散式支援涵蓋單一多 GPU 伺服器內的 data、tensor 與 pipeline 平行化，且平行化類型、寬度與 schedule 由使用者提供；多節點預測（最多 3840 節點）依賴分析式網路估算，未在真實叢集上驗證；訓練資料以 PyTorch 在 FP32 精度下蒐集；文字生成的推理延遲以產生第一個 token 的時間衡量（未建模 decode/KV cache）。
